services.desc: Join us in the gallery for this month's concert featuring The Musical Reunion. This performance brings together baroque violinist Ken Aiso, viola da gamba player David Garrett, and harpsichordist Sonia Lee. Laguna Live! at the Museum is presented in partnership with Laguna Beach Live! Laguna Beach Live! concerts are partially funded by the lodging establishments and City of Laguna Beach.
